content.text: **Cause found in logs:** the `monthly-spend-feature` flag flipped from `off` to `on` at 15:22, exactly at onset, producing a new `ZeroDivisionError` in `spend_summary.py:32`. No changes/deploys recorded in a 2.5-day window.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled from off to on at 2026-09-16T15:22:00Z, rolling out a code path in the account page spend summary that divides by zero. The error rate jumped from ~0.5% to 15.5% in that same minute and rose to ~34% as the rollout reached 100% of evaluations.

supporting_evidence.claim: INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations (every minute through 15:21)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
error_rate 0.005 at 15:21 then 0.155 at 15:22, 0.32 at 15:23, 0.345 at 15:27 with request_volume flat at 1200
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-14T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-16T15:27:39Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: a latent defect in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py shipped in some earlier deployment and only became reachable when the flag turned on. The evidence records no deploy in the 2.5 days before onset, so this cannot be substantiated and the toggle remains the proximate trigger.
